content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the failure to properly handle the case where the DSI host was not yet registered when the bridge attempted to attach to it. The original code returned an error code (-ENODEV) which prevented the bridge from being probed again later, leading to a situation where the bridge could not function correctly if it was initialized before the DSI host was available. The patch modifies the code to return -EPROBE_DEFER instead, allowing the probe to be retried later when the DSI host is registered.
